10.t: Working with data: identifying an unknown salt
q: Which two results show it is ionic?
High melting point; conducts when dissolved.
Identify the salt, and give its formula.
Sodium chloride, NaCl: sodium from the flame, chloride from the white silver nitrate precipitate.
Explain why the conductivity test alone cannot identify the salt.
Every soluble ionic compound conducts in solution; the test shows ions are present, not which ions.
